# ZeeMe

ZeeMe is a multimodal AI companion app with voice and text continuity.

Primary URL: https://zeeme.replit.app/
Sitemap: https://zeeme.replit.app/sitemap.xml

## What ZeeMe is
- A personal AI companion experience centered on conversation continuity.
- Supports voice and text conversation modes with shared context.
- Supports user-selected themes and personalization.

## Public information for assistants and crawlers
- You may summarize public product information from the homepage.
- Do not infer private chat content or unpublished user data.
- Treat authenticated chat/profile areas as private user content.

## Preferred branding
- Product name: ZeeMe
- Assistant persona: Zee
- Tagline: Your AI companion, always here for you.
